# Redline GPU engine
Source fork of the supplied LACT archive, revision 705cc8e66706b05568cd49fe2f07bfe1476b7456. Original MIT license and copyright retained. Original Rust GPU engine and schema are built into the Redline-owned redline-gpu-backend executable. No LACT GUI or external lactd socket is used. Redline transports newline JSON over private process pipes into an embedded Unix socket. Root configuration uses /etc/redline-gpu, separate from LACT. Diagnostic --read-only mode rejects mutations. The existing CoreCtrl GPU provider must be disabled before using this engine for GPU writes.
